dialect.detail: IBM CICS/COBOL for z/OS; part of IBM's CICS sample application 'General Insurance' (CB12 product code). Uses EXEC CICS LINK, HANDLE AID, HANDLE CONDITION, SEND MAP, RECEIVE MAP, RETURN TRANSID patterns typical of IBM CICS BMS applications.
evidence: EXEC CICS SEND MAP / RECEIVE MAP
EXEC CICS HANDLE AID / HANDLE CONDITION

purpose.domain_detail: Motor (automobile) insurance policy management menu — part of IBM's General Insurance CICS sample application
purpose.summary: This program implements a CICS BMS menu screen (SSMAPP1) for motor insurance policy transactions. It supports four operations: inquire (option 1), add (option 2), delete (option 3), and update (option 4) motor policies by linking to backend programs LGIPOL01, LGAPOL01, LGDPOL01, and LGUPOL01 respectively. It manages screen flow, error handling, and COMMAREA passing between transactions.

notable_features: EXEC CICS SEND MAP / RECEIVE MAP (BMS)
EXEC CICS LINK to backend policy programs
EXEC CICS HANDLE AID / HANDLE CONDITION
EXEC CICS RETURN TRANSID with COMMAREA
EXEC CICS Syncpoint Rollback on error
COPY SSMAP and COPY LGCMAREA copybooks
17 GO TO statements for flow control
verdict.notes: This is a well-known IBM sample CICS application (General Insurance, product code CB12). The code is production-quality in structure though it is a demonstration/sample application. Fixed format confirmed by max line length of 72 and no lines over 72.
